timing: Before reading target donor outcomes; source results already known.
purpose: Describe which frozen source-trained readouts transfer if observed-behavior prediction fails. No refit, threshold, estimator, layer or primary endpoint change.
decision_rule: Use the originally locked source model class predictions, equivalent to its fixed zero-logit boundary; no target calibration.
population: Source held-out worlds and target family-test worlds, separately. Non-prose primary presentations and heldout outcome_prose remain separate. Training/calibration worlds excluded.
tables: Per family and pooled: all assigned rows, observed forbidden choices, restricted-safe choices, authorized choices; by-presentation diagnostic counts. Publish confusion matrices, actual/predicted label counts, eligible/assigned counts, distinct worlds and label-class coverage. Balanced accuracy only when both source-trained binary classes are represented; otherwise null.
limits: High accuracy in a stratum with a constant actual label cannot establish general discrimination. Recoverable explicit cues are not evidence of subjective knowledge, causal use or a regulator. Conditioning on actions is descriptive; all earlier descriptor/structure limits and unsuccessful choices remain retained. No new causal qualification.
cost: Zero inference; operates only on saved fixed projections.
